failures.criterion: Changelog entries are fragment files that the fold takes (AGENTS.md 'Changelog entries are fragment files'; the architect's brief: a fragment, not a CHANGELOG edit)
failures.evidence: The head adds packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/pr-2411-migration-timestamps.yaml. packages/daemon has no .changie.yaml (ls: no such file), and .github/workflows/changelog-fold.yaml's CHANGELOG_PACKAGES (lines 65-68) does not list it. AGENTS.md line 540: 'A package without one, such as packages/daemon, has no fold.' Driven with the fold's own planner at this head: 'bash .github/scripts/release-push.sh fold-plan <the CHANGELOG_PACKAGES list>' exits 0 and plans 23 fragments, none under packages/daemon. The same command with packages/daemon added refuses: '::error::release-push.sh fold-plan: packages/daemon holds no CHANGELOG.md at HEAD to fold its fragments into'. So the fragment never folds and stays on main. Required fix, as the architect specified: delete packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/pr-2411-migration-timestamps.yaml and change nothing else. The packages/envoy fragment is right: it names no Dispatch key, and the fold's plan holds it for envoy's next release, as it does every unreleased fragment of a released package. I wrote no permanent red test. The only test that could catch this is a repository gate over every .changes/ directory, and main already holds three such daemon fragments (fix-open-roles-live.yaml, pr-2542-daemon-silent-cut.yaml, squash-commit-message.yaml), so the gate would fail on main itself. I am reporting those three to the controller as a defect outside this tree.
